claim: Each fixture runs in a new temporary directory.
sandbox: fresh temp contract; fixture writes a file; assert the project directory is untouched and the captured path is normalized

claim: Captures text, real TTY, and JSON output.
sandbox: fresh temp contract; assert stdout is a TTY in tty mode and JSON parses in json mode

claim: A later run reports when approved output changes.
sandbox: fresh temp contract; approve one output, change the declared probe mode, and assert the next check names the changed stdout snapshot

claim: Changing JSON fields are named across clean repeat runs.
sandbox: fresh temp contract producing a random run_id; assert the finding names $.meta.run_id

claim: Idempotency checks report output or exit changes on a second run.
sandbox: fresh temp contract whose command increments a fixture file; assert the second run is reported as changed

claim: Inline sample files are written inside each temporary fixture directory.
sandbox: fresh temp contract with an inline input.txt; assert the fixture reads its content and no file appears beside the contract

claim: A fixture is stopped when it exceeds timeout_ms.
sandbox: fresh temp contract running a five-second process with a 40 ms limit; assert the runner stops it and reports the limit

claim: Validates structured error codes and recovery commands.
sandbox: bundled CLI demo in its generated temporary directory; assert the expected failure exits 4 and recovery passes

claim: Writes Markdown and JSON reports.
sandbox: bundled CLI demo; read both reports and assert matching four-check pass results

claim: Declared secret values are redacted from snapshots and reports.
sandbox: fresh temp contract with a known sample token; assert no snapshot or report contains it

claim: Network use needs an explicit fixture opt-in.
where: landing facts and privacy section, README
sandbox: fresh temp contracts declaring curl and a Node fetch without allow_network; assert both are blocked

claim: The web demo stores only separate sample state and reset removes it.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; change the sample; assert only demo-prefixed state exists; reset and assert it is removed

claim: The website demo sends no data to third parties.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; intercept every request through a full sample run and assert all are same-origin

claim: Agent CLI Contract is free, open-source software under the MIT License.
sandbox: fresh clone; assert LICENSE grants free use and Cargo.toml declares MIT

claim: The CLI has no account, telemetry, analytics, or hosted service.
where: landing install note, README, privacy page
sandbox: fresh clone and bundled CLI demo; assert source and dependency lock contain no network or telemetry client path

claim: The CLI requires Rust 1.85 or newer.
sandbox: fresh clone; assert Cargo.toml declares rust-version 1.85 and the built binary reports version 0.1.0

claim: The runner uses declared executable arguments without a shell.
sandbox: fresh temp contract; inspect the runner and execute a Node argument containing shell metacharacters; assert it remains one literal argument

claim: The runner starts only the executable declared in the contract.
sandbox: fresh temp contract; assert the command schema has one declared executable and that the runner rejects an empty command

claim: Fixtures receive only a small environment and do not receive host secret variables.
sandbox: set a host-only secret; execute a fresh fixture and assert its output cannot read that variable

claim: The CLI demo never reads or writes project data.
sandbox: run the bundled demo from a temporary project containing a sentinel file; assert the sentinel remains unchanged and the reported demo path is outside the project

claim: Invalid or empty suites exit 2, contract failures exit 1, and passing suites exit 0.
sandbox: fresh invalid, failing, and accepted contracts; assert the documented exit codes

claim: Every --json check result is one script-readable JSON document.
sandbox: fresh valid contract without snapshots; assert its failure output parses once as a report object
